summary: Persian has enclitic/short copulas and long copulas; هست has important existential/emphatic uses, while نیست supplies core negative copular/existential forms.

semantic_map.SEM.IDENTITY_EQUIVALENCE: short/enclitic copula or است; long copula in licensed/emphatic contexts
semantic_map.SEM.CURRENT_STATE: state predicate + short or long copula by phonology/register/emphasis
semantic_map.SEM.RESULTANT_STATE: result-state predicate + copula or شدن-based change/result construction
semantic_map.SEM.ENTITY_LOCATION: locative phrase + long/short copula according to construction; هست commonly used
semantic_map.SEM.EXISTENCE_PRESENCE: هست / وجود دارد by existential/register context
semantic_map.SEM.POSSESSION_AS_EXISTENCE: ordinary possession uses داشتن; existential هست expresses availability/presence but is not the default possessive
